messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large quadrupedal creature with the overall shape, fur, head and paws of a brown bear, shown in side profile walking to the right. Its body is covered in thick shaggy brown fur with a lighter cream underbelly and chest. Integrated into the fur are multiple glossy dark-brown to black beetle-like exoskeleton plates on the back, flanks, shoulders, throat, and around the leg joints and ankles. A single long, curved, glossy black beetle horn with side teeth rises from its forehead between its small rounded bear ears.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown furry bear head with long tan snout, black nose, and small dark eyes", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body facing right"}, {"looks_like": "long glossy black curved beetle horn with small side prongs", "part": "horn", "where": "on the forehead between the ears"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry brown bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head behind the horn"}, {"looks_like": "large bulky brown furry bear torso with lighter cream fur on the underbelly and chest", "part": "torso", "where": "forming the main body between the head and hindquarters"}, {"looks_like": "thick furry brown bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the torso, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry bear paws with long pale claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs"}, {"looks_like": "short furry brown bear tail", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark brown to black beetle exoskeleton plates including ridged elytra-like covers and angular shoulder and joint shields", "part": "shell plates", "where": "embedded in the fur on the back, sides, shoulders, throat, and around the knees and ankles"}, {"looks_like": "rows of small dark oval spiracle-like spots in the fur", "part": "markings", "where": "along the lower side of the torso and on the throat and chest"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
